ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New client, Client won and later stages need Client agreement signed and Close date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_client", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Initial meeting booked", 2, "Initial meeting held", 3, "Fee proposal", 4, "Agreement out", 5, "Client won", 6, 0) >= 6, OR(NOT(Engagement_signed__c), ISBLANK(CloseDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Client agreement signed and Close date before moving to Client won.
